why: Words the story episodes teach, pinned to the place that teaches them. Everything else is spread round-robin so each place still gets a comparable mix. Without this, a market episode would have to be written around whichever arbitrary words the round-robin happened to deal it - the market partition held 血液, 競馬 and 国籍 - which makes the Japanese worse for no gain in coverage. Coverage is a property of the practice pool, not of which forty words a story happens to teach.
